verses.text: A poor person who lives with integrity is better off than a fool whose words twist what's right.
Passion without knowledge does no good. Rush ahead and you'll miss the way.
People wreck their own path through foolishness, then rage at the LORD in their hearts.
Money brings plenty of friends, but even a friend walks away from a poor person.
A false witness won't go unpunished. Someone who pours out lies won't go free.
People line up to win a ruler's favor. Everyone wants to be friends with someone who gives gifts.
Even a poor person's relatives avoid them. How much more do their friends keep away! They call after them and plead, but they're gone.
Get wisdom and you show love for your own life. Hold on to understanding and you'll find good things.
A false witness won't go unpunished. Someone who tells lies will perish.
A life of luxury doesn't suit a fool, much less a servant ruling over princes.
Good judgment makes you slow to anger. Letting an offense go is something to be proud of.
A king's anger is like a lion's roar. His favor is like dew on the grass.
A foolish son is a disaster for his father. A wife's quarrels are like a drip that never stops.
You can inherit a house and wealth from your parents, but a wife with good judgment comes from the LORD.
Laziness sends you into a deep sleep. An idle person will go hungry.
Keep the command and you'll guard your life. Treat your ways with contempt and you'll die.
Show mercy to poor people and you're lending to the LORD. He'll pay you back.
Discipline your son while there's hope. Don't willingly let him go to his death.
A hothead has to face the consequences. Bail them out and you'll have to do it again.
Listen to advice and take instruction so you'll be wise later in life.
People make all kinds of plans in their hearts. The LORD's purpose is what will stand.
Kindness is what makes a person worth knowing. It's better to be poor than to be a liar.
Reverence for the LORD leads to life. You'll rest content, untouched by trouble.
A slacker buries their hand in the dish and won't even bring the food to their mouth.
Punish a mocker and the inexperienced will learn good judgment. Correct someone with understanding and they'll gain knowledge.
A son who robs his father and drives away his mother brings shame and disgrace.
My son, stop listening to instruction and you'll wander away from words of knowledge.
A corrupt witness makes fun of justice. The wicked gulp down wrongdoing.
Punishment is ready for mockers, and beatings are ready for the backs of fools.
